subject: Order Form: publicity, logo custody & reference rights — redlines
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@acme.com
Date: 2025-06-15 09:12 -0700
Subject: Order Form redlines: publicity / logo custody / reference rights

Hi Lauren,

Please find attached our redlined MSA & Order Form (v3). Legal flagged three items we need clarity on before we can route for signature:

1) Publicity / press releases: Your standard clause seems broad — requests to limit to pre-approved quotes and to require 30 days notice before any press.
2) Logo custody and usage: we need an explicit requirement for where logos are stored and who verifies approved assets (we'd prefer an escrow or SFTP plus checksum).
3) Reference rights: we can agree to being listed as a customer for sales material only for non-confidential use; need examples of acceptable quotes.

Can you review and propose narrow language we can sign off on? We're aiming to finalize by the end of next week if possible.

Attachments: [Attachment: redline_MSA_OrderForm_v3.docx (docx)], [Attachment: evidence_brand_guidelines.pdf (pdf)]

Best,
Jordan Ellis
Head of Partnerships, Acme Analytics
(j.ellis@acme.com)
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-15 11:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Order Form redlines: publicity / logo custody / reference rights

Jordan — thanks for the redlines and callout. Quick reply with proposed path: we can accept materially narrower publicity language with a short set of guardrails; below are the high-level commitments we can make, I’ve attached our suggestion in the redline doc.

- Quiet period: propose 30 days notice for customer-initiated press that references product performance; Redwood requests 10 business days to review any draft quote.
- Quotes: Acme must mark any quote as non-confidential and provide evidence it’s okay to publish (email from your internal stakeholder).
- Logos: we do not require a third-party escrow but will accept delivery via SFTP or secure Drive link and require a checksum and brand usage file; Redwood will only use logos per your guidelines.
- Reference rights: allow customer listing and case study excerpts for non-sensitive engagements; full case studies need joint sign-off.

I’ve looped in Marissa (marketing ops) to prepare a short evidence checklist for what we need to approve quotes and Ben and David for legal/finance impact. If Acme can accept the attached markup, we’ll prepare the signable Order Form and route via DocuSign.

Attachments: [Attachment: redline_MSA_OrderForm_v3.docx (redline with our comments)], [Attachment: logo_asset_list.zip (zip)]

Thanks — Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Date: 2025-06-15 11:45 -0700
Subject: Internal: RE: Order Form redlines from Acme — who's owning what

Marissa / Ben / David — forwarding Jordan's redlines and my reply. Quick asks: 

- Marissa: please draft a 1-page evidence checklist ("what Acme must provide to clear a quote/release") — include required files, point of contact verification, and asset checksum.
- Ben: can you run a quick revenue-impact check if we add the SFTP/logo delivery requirement? Will this delay signing or add ops work?
- David: can you review my markup and confirm the proposed 30-day notice + 10 business day review window is legally acceptable, or recommend precise wording.

I want to avoid a long back-and-forth — if we can present a single clean compromise to Acme tomorrow, we should be able to hit their timeline.

Quoted for context:
> On 2025-06-15 09:12 -0700, Jordan Ellis wrote:
> > Please find attached our redlined MSA & Order Form (v3). Legal flagged three items we need clarity on before we can route for signature: ...

Thanks,
Lauren
From: Acme Analytics Legal <contracts@acme.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.com>
Date: 2025-06-16 10:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Order Form redlines: publicity / logo custody / reference rights

Hi Lauren — thanks for the quick reply and suggested edits. We discussed internally and can offer the following compromise: 

- Quiet period: agree to a notice window but prefer 60 days rather than 30 for certain performance claims. We can do 60 days for performance-focused releases, 30 days for product announcements.
- Logos: cannot commit to escrow; we will provide official assets via our CDN with a URL and usage manifest. We will not provide SFTP credentials to vendors.
- Quotes/reference rights: we can permit customer listing and short excerpt quotes that Acme pre-approves; we will provide a point of contact for approvals.

Please see our attached counter-redline (redline_MSA_OrderForm_v3_contracts.docx). If Redwood can accept the two-track quiet period (30 / 60) and accept logos via CDN with a signed usage manifest, we can sign this week.

Attachments: [Attachment: redline_MSA_OrderForm_v3_contracts.docx (docx)]

Jordan Ellis
Head of Partnerships (on behalf of Acme Legal)
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Acme Analytics Legal <contracts@acme.com>, Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-18 16:22 -0700
Subject: Final: Order Form publicity & logo terms — narrow acceptance with small edits

Jordan / Acme Legal — thanks for the counter. We discussed internally and can accept the two-track quiet period as a compromise with slight edits: 45 days for performance claims, 30 days for product announcements. Rationale: keeps your longer runway for sensitive performance items while giving Redwood a fixed review SLA.

Logo delivery: we will accept CDN-hosted official assets if Acme provides a signed usage manifest + a downloadable archive for our records (we can pull via the CDN or you can drop a checksum-verified archive on the Drive link below). We cannot accept an open-ended "CDN only" approach without an archival copy.

Quotes/reference rights: agreed to allow customer listing and short excerpts for non-confidential items; full case studies require joint sign-off and a final draft 10 business days before planned release.

Next steps:
- If Acme agrees, please approve the attached final signable Order Form and route via DocuSign to lauren_bishop@redwood.com.
- Marissa will prepare the evidence checklist and an onboarding email template for asset delivery.
